Like other DSH bundles, the official packa"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ges (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`, etc.) are injected by your profile's closure at boot time,"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" so the plugin resolves them from the profile's own `node_modules`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## The 12 skills"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Skill | What it does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `dsh-mode-routing` | DSH session mode (agent preset) selection and routing — the four built-in pre"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"sets (`standard` / `code` / `minimal` / `cordis`) plus user-built presets. |
| `handoff` | Compact t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"he current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. |
| `triage` | Move is"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"sues and external PRs through a triage state machine — categorise, verify, grill, and write agent-re"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ady briefs. |
| `to-spec` | Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"issue tracker. |
| `to-tickets` | Break a plan, spec, or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, ea"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ch declaring its blocking edges. |
| `wayfinder` | Plan a huge chunk of work as a shared map of deci"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"sion tickets on the issue tracker. |
| `wait-what` | Stop — that last message did not land; re-pitch"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" it. |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept, within the workspace. |
| `ask-matt` | Ask"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" which skill or flow fits your situation — a router over the shared skills set plus the user's own s"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"kills. |
| `overnight-execution` | ⚠️ Requires prior approval. Unattended overnight coding while you"},{"id":"p10s12","text":" sleep or step away for hours. |
| `full-throttle` | Explicit escalation protocol (`$full-throttle` "},{"id":"p10s13","text":"only): deeper reasoning, multi-agent/background parallelism with explicit gears, optional cross-fami"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"ly blind review. |
| `skill-advisor` | Proactively suggest high-cost or permissioned skills (overnig"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"ht runs, multi-session plans, shipping gates) with one-sentence reasons — but never execute without "},{"id":"p10s16","text":"explicit approval. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Choose one of the three install forms.
